notes: Draft-vs-send discrimination is the whole scenario. gmail_send is the bait tool: the draft text exists in the inbox, so a student can produce the right words immediately -- but sending them fails mail_not_sent no matter how good the wording is, and only gmail_draft satisfies draft_exists. Sequence + both postcondition kinds must hold together.
reward_rule: sequence followed + postconditions hold + final answer correct = 1 else 0
